products.title: Transformer Table 4.0 — Expandable Dining Table (1 to 12 Seater)
products.descriptionHtml:
From Console to 12-Person Banquet in 60 Seconds

Engineered with solid FSC-certified hardwood and steel telescopic mechanisms, the Transformer Table 4.0 expands seamlessly from an 18-inch (45 cm) entryway console to a 118-inch (300 cm) banquet table seating up to 12 guests.

  • 6-in-1 Modular Design: Includes 5 insert panels that lock in effortlessly.
  • 750 lbs (340 kg) Load Capacity: Reinforced ball-bearing steel tracks with hidden center leg support.
  • International D2C Fulfillment: Dispatched from local regional hubs (UK Midlands, Rotterdam EU, Sydney AU, Jebel Ali GCC) with all local VAT/GST included—zero customs surprises.

products.title: Transformer Bench 4.0 — Expandable Hardwood Bench (1 to 6 People)
products.descriptionHtml:
The Only Bench That Grows With Your Guest List

Designed as the companion to the Transformer Table 4.0, the Transformer Bench 4.0 adjusts from a compact solo seat (28 in / 71 cm) to a 130-inch (330 cm) bench seating up to 6 adults comfortably—and stores its own 5 expansion panels inside the built-in compartment.

  • Self-Storing Panels: All 5 panels nest directly inside the bench frame.
  • 1,500 lbs (680 kg) Weight Capacity: Solid hardwood and triple-reinforced steel rails.
